generations.text: Daniel Natarajan contacted support because the Aero 2 stops charging after a few minutes since 2026-01-08. It is a Low priority case and the status is currently Closed. The agent offered a credit of $89.00. The knowledge base notes that Aero 2 firmware 3.2 fixes the charging fault on the dock. The customer sounds frustrated and wants a quick resolution.

Use only the case, its comments and the knowledge passages below.
